title: How delivery to every region of Uzbekistan works
excerpt: DADO products are delivered to all 14 regions, including the Republic of Karakalpakstan. Here is how the process works from order to unloading on site.
body:
Porcelain stoneware and ceramic tile are a heavy and fragile cargo. That is why delivery quality matters as much as product quality. DADO organises delivery to all 14 regions of Uzbekistan, including the Republic of Karakalpakstan.

The process begins with order confirmation. A manager checks the required quantity, formats and batch consistency. Tiles for one project are assembled from a single batch wherever possible, so there are no shade differences.

Tiles are shipped in factory packaging, on pallets secured with film. Each pallet is marked with the format, colour and batch number, which makes acceptance on site easier.

Delivery time depends on the region and the order volume. The exact date is agreed at order confirmation. For large projects, a phased delivery schedule can be arranged.

On acceptance, we recommend opening the pallets and inspecting the tiles. If you have questions, call +998 78 150 00 02; our specialists stay in touch at every stage.
